summary: The table presents a financial performance overview for the periods ending March 31, 2025, and March 31, 2024, highlighting key metrics such as revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit. It compares these metrics across the two years and includes a growth percentage for each. Notable insights include a revenue increase of 3.9% and a gross profit growth of 5.1%. Operating profit and net profit before minority interest show slight variations, with operating profit increasing by 6.2%. The table also details earnings per share (EPS) and dividend per share, with the latter showing a significant growth of 13.2%.
